info.title: Totalis Hyperliquid API
info.description:
REST API for Totalis singles and parlays on Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets, for client integrations and external market makers.

Authenticate with a scoped API key created in the Totalis app, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Public market reads need no key. Balance-affecting commands also carry the wallet or maker signature the HyperEVM contract verifies.

Amounts are base-10 strings in native USDC atomic units, large identifiers are decimal strings, and every command `POST` requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.

WebSocket upgrade for authenticated, principal-scoped committed updates. Browser clients request totalis.realtime.v1 plus auth.<base64url-access-token>; non-browser clients may use the bearer header. See protocol/asyncapi/realtime.json; HTTP resource reads and maker snapshot/replay are recovery paths. Dashboard members select maker_id with account_contract=1, chain_id and vault; all four financial read permissions are required. Membership revision or controller epoch changes close the connection. RFQ detail subscriptions remain transport-credential only.

Requires one of:

- a personal key with `account:stream`
- a maker key with `rfq:read`
- a maker key with `vault:read` and the maker permissions `READ_ACTIVITY`, `READ_CAPITAL`, `READ_PERFORMANCE`, `READ_POSITIONS`
- a maker key with `quote:read`
- a personal key with `rfq:read`

Also requires `replay:read` to resume from a cursor or replay retained events.

Each key receives only the frames its scopes allow, and other frame classes are denied:

| Frames | Key | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open RFQ discovery | personal key | `rfq:read` |
| Account | personal key | `account:stream` |
| RFQ | maker key | `rfq:read` |
| Quote | maker key | `quote:read` |
| Account | maker key | `vault:read` and the maker permissions `READ_CAPITAL`, `READ_POSITIONS`, `READ_ACTIVITY`, `READ_PERFORMANCE` |

Returns the selected linked main account's read-only authoritative HyperCore USDC balances, HIP-4 balances, open orders, recent ordinary fills, and at most 200 durably retained USDC settlement credits. Each read qualifies at most 16 distinct unseen outcomes newest settlement first; a block of at least 16 recent unsupported outcomes can still delay older supported outcomes pending TT-1476. Outcomes quoted in another currency are omitted only after identity and settlement fraction agree, while malformed or contradictory authority fails closed. Settlement discovery uses one provider-capped userFillsByTime response covering at most the last 30 days, without pagination, so it is not complete account history. Mainnet only.

Requires a personal key with `account:read`.

200.description: Current direct HyperCore portfolio and balances

get.description:
Returns registered-account observations, never authoritative balances or execution. Each section defaults to its newest 200 rows since registration. Supply both from and through as RFC3339 timestamps for a half-open interval of at most 31 days. Sections report truncation independently. Orders are the latest known states of orders placed within the interval, not an as-of reconstruction. Conversions retain each native leg separately and are not trades. Unknown cash delta kinds remain unsupported evidence with explicit gaps. Complete is false before registration, beyond typed coverage, across a gap, or on truncation. Delivery progress alone never proves coverage.

Requires a personal key with `account:read`.

parameters.name: through
parameters.description: Exclusive interval end. Requires from; maximum interval is 31 days.

Category.name: category
Category.description: Platform taxonomy category slug. The cursor is bound to this filter.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive RFC3339 window start. Omit from and to together for the exact rolling 24 hours ending at server time; supplying only one is rejected. The response repeats the resolved bounds, which later pages must reuse.

HistoryIncludeGaps.name: include_gaps
HistoryIncludeGaps.description: Include at most 1440 retained diagnostic gap records. Display-only clients that consume bars may disable them.

HistoryLimit.name: limit
HistoryLimit.description: Retained history rows per page; 1,440 covers a full 24-hour one-minute window. Each selected outcome, side and source has at most one retained row per minute.

HistorySeries.name: series
HistorySeries.description: AUTO selects retained closed trade buckets in the window, otherwise reference history. REFERENCE_PRICE_OHLC prefers L2, then BBO, then allMids among sources with a closed bucket in the window; with none it carries the most recent earlier source inside the 90-day online window, breaking ties in that order. With no evidence the empty reference response is labelled L2/BOOK_MID. Explicit series avoids AUTO switching when trades arrive.

Subcategory.name: subcategory
Subcategory.description: Platform taxonomy subcategory slug. The cursor is bound to this filter.

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive RFC3339 window end, at most 24 hours after from. Omit from and to together for the server default.

BookQuotesChangedPayload.description: Advisory invalidation of an authenticated RFQ book. Reread the authoritative book; this payload is never an executable quote.

CombinedFundingRequest.description: Funds one stake from Hyperliquid Core spot USDC and the embedded wallet at once. Both amounts are authorized before the maker is asked, and core.value + wallet.value must equal the exact shortfall recomputed at admission.

wallet.description: EIP-3009 authorization for the wallet part. valid_before must be strictly after the quote expiry, because the vault draws it only after Core evidence arrives and still accepts a quote on its expiry second, when an equal valid_before has already expired.

value.description: Exact requested shortfall in integer USDC-6; recomputed at admission.

builder_code.description: Optional integrator attribution code. Requires builder_authorization_expiry and builder_signature from the integrator's registered signer. Revocation rejects new RFQs without vetoing an already-created RFQ.

builder_authorization_expiry.description: Unix-second expiry, at most five minutes ahead, included in the Totalis RFQ builder authorization personal-sign message.

builder_signature.description: Registered integrator signer personal-sign signature. Message lines are: Authorize Totalis RFQ builder attribution.; Environment: <APP_ENV>; Participant: <participant UUID>; Idempotency key: <UUID>; Request digest: 0x<SHA-256>; Expiry: <builder_authorization_expiry>. The request digest is SHA-256 of minified JSON with ordered keys intent_id and intent_generation when supplied, followed by taker_address, stake_amount, legs, builder_code, origin.

resolution_deadline.description: Legacy buffered source-date metadata retained for compatibility. Neither this value nor its buffer controls trading, visibility or settlement.

safety_buffer_seconds.description: Legacy source-date encoding only; not an execution buffer.

Eligibility.description: Each row applies only to its exact product and capability. An absent row for a required scope is ineligible and is never synthesized as REVIEW or CURRENT.

state.description: Stored exit state. Refresh GET /v1/core-exits/{exit_id} for the full resource.

FactorNumerator.description: Native result numerator in the inclusive range zero through Q = 100000000.

HypercoreAccountHistory.description: Durably observed Hypercore history for the caller's own account. It is never an authority for current balances or for whether an action executed.

HypercoreHistoryCashEvent.description: Node-first LedgerUpdate history for listed registered accounts. Supported kinds are send, spotTransfer, deposit, withdraw, accountClassTransfer, internalTransfer, subAccountTransfer and accountActivationGas. Unknown kinds preserve unsupported evidence and gaps, not balance semantics. QuickNode supplies bounded repair only.

fee_token.description: Present with a fee. Empty only when the fee is zero.

transfer_direction.description: Account-class transfer direction, not inferred balance changes.

HypercoreHistoryConversion.description: One immutable native conversion leg, never a counterparty trade. Identity includes fill_id, outcome_id, market_side and direction; legs can share a venue hash and trade ID.

HypercoreHistoryCoverage.description: The boundaries of observed history. An unobserved account reports observed false rather than an empty history.

history_start_at.description: First instant covered. Activity before it was never reconstructed and is not claimed.

covered_through_at.description: Minimum available source checkpoint across polling settlement repair, typed fills/orders and cash coverage from the misc lane or bounded repair. Unsupported sources, gaps, and complete describe coverage limitations. Raw delivery receipts never imply coverage.

complete.description: True only when the requested half-open interval starts at or after registration, ends at or before covered_through_at, has no intersecting gaps or unsupported sections, and no section is truncated. Orders are latest observations for orders placed in the interval, not an as-of reconstruction or every status transition.

gaps_truncated.description: True when older gaps are omitted from the latest 200. Absence of a listed gap must not be treated as proof of complete coverage.

unsupported.description: CASH_LEDGER remains until durable cash coverage exists from node misc LedgerUpdate consumption or bounded initial/gap repair. ORDER_HISTORY remains until post-start typed order-stream coverage exists. Earlier stream intervals remain gaps. No historicalOrders call is used.

identity.description: Transaction hash and positive authority trade ID; partial fills remain distinct.

fee.description: Exact fee Hyperliquid reported, including builder fees.

HypercoreHistoryGap.description: A window the observer could not read completely. Coverage is never complete across a gap.

reason.description: LOG_START precedes the first typed stream observation. LOG_GAP is a missing source interval. LOG_EXPIRED is expired raw retention. LOG_QUARANTINE is uninterpretable source evidence. Unsupported cash deltas retain evidence without inferred financial meaning. Gaps remain explicit after late replay.

HypercoreHistoryOrder.description: An order the observer has seen. UNRESOLVED means its order ID is known from a fill but its status has not been read. UNOBSERVABLE means Hyperliquid no longer reports the order ID.

settlement_credits.description: At most 200 durably retained USDC credits. Each read qualifies at most 16 distinct unseen outcomes newest settlement first; a block of at least 16 recent unsupported outcomes can still delay older supported outcomes pending TT-1476. Outcomes quoted in another currency are omitted only after identity and settlement fraction agree; malformed or contradictory authority fails closed. Discovery uses one provider-capped userFillsByTime response over the last 30 days and is not complete account history.

cloid.description: Client order ID when supplied by Hyperliquid for the open order.

HypercoreSettlementCredit.description: A Hyperliquid HIP-4 settlement fill retained as an immutable net USDC credit projection.

settlement_fraction.description: Outcome-level YES settlement fraction. A NO share's gross fraction is one minus this value.

fee_usdc.description: Exact total USDC fee reported for the settlement fill. Builder fees are already included.

credited_usdc.description: Exact net USDC credit: shares times the side payout fraction minus fee_usdc.

IntegerValue.description: Nonnegative integer value paired with an explicit positive scale.

feed_generation.description: Null until a qualified reference generation has been persisted.

from.description: Authoritative window start. It repeats the request, or the rolling 24-hour default when from and to are both omitted. Reuse these bounds for later pages.

bucket_time.description: minute is the inclusive UTC bucket start on this clock; bucket end is exclusive one minute later. Only full closed buckets contained in [from,to) appear in bars.

closed_before.description: Exclusive bucket boundary, the earlier of to or server time rounded down to a minute. This is not a persistence or coverage watermark. Closed buckets can still be repaired.

anchor.description: Latest retained earlier full bucket within the 90-day online window for the selected source and side, whose last_received_at precedes from. Its close is an observed price, not proof that the value held through from. Preserve its original source, generations, scale and times.

series.description: Cumulative net realized P&L at UTC day boundaries within the requested interval, from the same revision as totals. Empty when unavailable; omitted by older servers. Amounts are atomic units of net_trading_pnl.asset.

PositiveInt64.description: Positive generation or version bounded by signed int64 storage.

PositiveInt64String.description: Positive signed 64-bit decimal integer, at most 9223372036854775807.

deployer.description: outcomeMeta identifies the venue owner, not the outcome creator; never infer creator from venue ownership.

deadline.description: Consumers-first rollout accepts the previous producer deadline without timing; current producers emit the full temporal deadline. Unknown fields remain rejected.

QuoteDisplayPayload.description: New display events carry a complete typed offer. Retained legacy events may omit it and require snapshot recovery.

oneOf.description: Retained removal: remove the exact digest; an absent reason does not imply withdrawal.

RealQuestionId.description: A real native question identifier; the standalone NO_QUESTION sentinel is excluded.

RecurringPrice.description: Exact deployer price text; never reformatted or rounded.

expiry.description: Exact deployer settlement instant in Unix seconds; no safety buffer is applied.

target_price.description: PRICE_BINARY settles YES when the interpolated mark price is at or above this value.

price_thresholds.description: Ascending PRICE_BUCKET boundaries; the three buckets cover < P1, [P1, P2) and >= P2.

native_question_id.description: Parent question of a bucket round; null for a standalone binary round.

catalog_state.description: NOT_LISTED means the round is durably recorded but absent from the current catalog generation, so its market and question routes return 404.

previous_state.description: BEFORE_RECORDED_HISTORY means Totalis never observed an earlier round; it never claims that none existed. CONFLICTED means the nearest earlier round was observed but its recorded definition is withheld.

next_state.description: NONE_RECORDED means Totalis has not observed a later round; it never claims none was published. CONFLICTED means the nearest later round was observed but its recorded definition is withheld.

index.description: Bucket position the child market states for itself; null unless the role is NAMED.

underlying.description: Deployer instrument name, optionally prefixed with a provider namespace.

RecurringSeries.description: Hyperliquid guarantees at most one recurring series per network, class, underlying and period.

Scale.description: Positive base-10 scale for an integer value.

admission_cutoff_at.description: Legacy metadata only. Does not control market visibility or Combo entry. Use native lifecycle and eligibility.

admission_policy.description: Legacy classification retained for existing clients; no separate Totalis admission calendar is enforced.

Timing.description: Reviewed UTC source windows and retained legacy admission metadata. These fields do not control trading availability. Null times require external evidence or are not defined. Settlement boundaries never promise settlement or mutate native lifecycle.

V1MarketDataPositiveInt64.description: Positive generation or version bounded by signed int64 storage.

Error503.description: Required read source or contract unavailable

Retry-After.description: Seconds until this quota can admit another request

apiKey.description: Scoped API key from the Totalis app settings. Personal keys act for one account; maker keys act for one maker. Each operation lists the scopes it requires.
